Overview

Nekemte is a city in Oromia with a population of 120,000. A historic city in western Ethiopia, a major center for the Oromo people and the coffee trade. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
